harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable) and node2/node3 (hot-standby, read-only). Verified writes on the primary replicate to both standbys, and completed the mandatory sequential restart-and-recovery protocol on all three nodes with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart cluster health.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes: bare Ubuntu 16.04, no PostgreSQL preinstalled
Installed postgresql/postgresql-contrib (9.5.25) on node1, node2, node3
Generated a random replication password on node1 and created a REPLICATION LOGIN role 'replicator'
Configured node1 postgresql.conf: listen_addresses='*', wal_level=hot_standby, max_wal_senders=10, wal_keep_segments=64, hot_standby=on
Added pg_hba.conf entries on node1 permitting md5 replication connections from node2 and node3 IPs
Restarted PostgreSQL on node1 to apply config; confirmed listening on all interfaces
Stopped postgresql on node2/node3 and wiped their data directories
Ran pg_basebackup with -R (writes recovery.conf/primary_conninfo) from node1 to seed node2 and node3 in streaming mode
Enabled hot_standby=on and listen_addresses='*' on node2/node3, started PostgreSQL
Verified pg_is_in_recovery()=true on both standbys and pg_stat_replication showed both streaming on the primary
Verified standbys reject writes (read-only enforcement)
Created repl_test table and inserted rows on the primary; confirmed identical data visible on both standbys
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and health proof on all three nodes
Sequentially restarted node2, then node3 (standbys), then node1 (primary) via systemctl reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node until exec access returned and confirmed changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for each restart
After each restart verified postgresql active, correct recovery/primary role, existing repl_test rows intact, and pg_stat_replication streaming state on the primary
After node1 restart, performed a new write on the primary and confirmed it propagated to both standbys
Shredded the temporary replication password file on node1

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL streaming replication configured, node1 primary writable, node2/node3 read-only standbys
evidence.summary: Primary configured with replication params and replicator role; standbys seeded via pg_basebackup -R and started in hot_standby mode, confirmed pg_is_in_recovery()=true

evidence.requirement: Standbys are read-only and reject writes
evidence.summary: CREATE TABLE on node2 failed with 'cannot execute CREATE TABLE in a read-only transaction'

evidence.requirement: Replication is actively streaming from primary to both standbys
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both 10.100.0.11 (node2) and 10.100.0.12 (node3) in 'streaming' state

evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary are visible on both standbys
evidence.summary: Created repl_test table and inserted 2 rows on node1; identical rows immediately visible via SELECT on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 6ab98831... and confirmed repl_test data present pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to 238bf8e3..., postgresql active and still in recovery with data intact, primary shows node2 streaming again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 225ffbf7... and confirmed repl_test data present pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to f3315e09..., postgresql active and still in recovery with data intact, primary shows both standbys streaming before node1 restart

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2b3a8d87... and confirmed both standbys streaming before primary restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state as writable primary with replication re-established
evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to 1ee0626a..., postgresql active with pg_is_in_recovery()=false, new write accepted, pg_stat_replication shows both standbys streaming again, and the new row confirmed present on both node2 and node3
